newsitem.title: CHINA: Bayer in $12.5 mln China plastics project.
newsitem.headline: Bayer in $12.5 mln China plastics project.

text.p: Bayer AG said on Thursday it had reached agreement with a Chinese company to set up a $12.5 million joint venture to produce polycarbonate engineering materials for the domestic construction industry.

Bayer's unit, Bayer (China) Ltd, would hold 70 percent of the joint venture, to be called Bayer Guangyi Polycarbonate Panel Co Ltd, while Beijing Guangyi Polycarbonate Panel Co Ltd would hold 30 percent.
The joint venture, based in Beijing, would have an initial output of 2,100 tonnes per year of the plastic material used as an insulator in engineering projects. No timetable was given for production.
